items.text: Yesu ahejeje kuvuga ivyo vyose, abwira abigishwa biwe ati:
Muri ico gihe nyene, abaherezi bakurubakuru hamwe n’abakuru b’Abayuda, bari bakoraniye mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru Kayafa,
kugira ngo barabe ingene bofata Yesu mu mpisho, hanyuma bamwice.
Barumvikana bati: “Ariko ntidukwiye kumufata mu misi mikuru kuko abantu bohava bagumuka.”
Ico gihe, Yesu yari i Betaniya, mu nzu kwa Simoni yahoze ari umunyamibembe.
Ariko arafungura haza umugore aramwegera afise icupa ryiza ririmwo amavuta amota cane kandi y’igiciro kinini, maze ayamusuka ku mutwe bicaye mu buriro.
Abigishwa babibonye ntibabishima baca bavuga bati: “Mbega ubu buhombe ni ubw’iki?
Aya mavuta yari kugurishwa amahera menshi agafasha aboro.”
Yesu amenye ivyo bariko baravuga, aca ababwira ati:
Hanyuma Yuda Isikariyote, umwe muri ba bigishwa cumi na babiri, aragenda aja kurondera abaherezi bakurubakuru,
arababaza ati: “Hamwe nobaha Yesu mwompa iki?” Baca bamuha ibiceri vy’ifeza mirongo itatu.
Kuva uwo mwanya aca atangura kurondera akaryo keza ko kumubashikiriza.
Ku musi wa mbere w’imisi mikuru y’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, abigishwa baza aho Yesu ari baramubaza bati: “Ni hehe ugomba ko tugutegurira ivyokurya vya Pasika?”
Arabishura ati:
Ba bigishwa baragenda babikora nk’uko Yesu yabibabwiye, bategura ivyokurya vya Pasika.
Ku mugoroba, Yesu yicarana ku meza n’abigishwa biwe cumi na babiri.
Bariko barafungura, Yesu avuga ati:
Abigishwa biwe barababara cane, umwe wese atangura kuvuga ati: “Mwami, nibaza ko atari jewe!”
Yesu arabishura ati:
Maze Yuda, uwari yateguye kumugurisha na we nyene avuga ati: “None yoba ari jewe ga Mwigisha?”
Yesu aramwishura ati:
Bariko barafungura, Yesu afata umukate, awushimira Imana, arawumanyura, awuha abigishwa biwe, avuga ati:
Yongera afata igikombe, agishimira Imana, arakibaha, ati:
Bahejeje kuririmba barasohoka, baja ku Musozi wa Elayono.
Bariko baragenda Yesu arababwira ati:
Petero aramwishura ati: “Naho abandi bose boguta bagahunga, jewe sinzokwigera ndaguta.”
Yesu aramwishura ati:
Ariko Petero arasubira avuga ati: “Sinshobora kukwihakana ngo sindakuzi naho vyonsaba gupfana nawe.” Mbere n’abandi bigishwa bavuga batyo.
Hanyuma Yesu ajana n’abigishwa biwe ahantu hitwa Getsemane, arababwira ati:
Ahitana Petero na bene Zebedayo, hanyuma atangura kugira umubabaro mwinshi n’agahinda.
Arababwira ati:
Nuko yigira imbere, yubama hasi arasenga ati:
Hanyuma agaruka aho abigishwa biwe bari asanga basinziriye. Abaza Petero ati:
Asubirayo ubugira kabiri arasenga ati:
Agarutse, asanga basubiriye gusinzira, kuko amaso yabo yari aremerewe cane n’itiro.
Maze yongera kubasiga ngaho asubira gusenga ubugira gatatu, avuga amajambo nk’amwe ya mbere.
Agarutse aho abigishwa biwe bari, ababwira ati:
Yesu akiriko aravuga, Yuda umwe muri ba bigishwa cumi na babiri, arashika. Inyuma yiwe hari isinzi ry’abantu bitwaje inkota n’amahiri, barungitswe n’abaherezi bakurubakuru hamwe n’abakuru b’Abayuda.
Yuda, uwari yamugurishije yari yabahaye ikimenyetso, ababwira ati: “Uwo nja gusoma azoba ari we, muce mumufata.”
Maze Yuda aca agenda atumbereye Yesu, avuga ati: “Ndakuramukije Rabi!” Aca aramusoma.
Yesu aramubwira ati:
Ba bantu baca bashorera amaboko kuri Yesu, baramufata.
Umwe mu bari kumwe na Yesu aca asokora inkota yiwe, ayikubita umukozi w’umuherezi mukuru, amuca ugutwi.
Yesu aca amubwira ati:
Legiyono imwe igizwe n’abasoda ibihumbi bitandatu.
Hanyuma Yesu abwira ba bantu benshi baje kumufata ati:
Ubwo nyene abigishwa biwe bose baramuta barahunga.
Abaje gufata Yesu bamujana mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru Kayafa, ahari hakoraniye abigisha b’ivyagezwe hamwe n’abakuru b’Abayuda.
Ariko Petero we, aguma inyuma yiwe, amukurikira agendera kure, kugeza ashitse mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru. Ashitse yicarana n’abarinzi b’urugo, ngo arabe amaherezo.
Abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abagize inama nkuru y’idini ry’Abayuda bagerageza kurondera ibirego vyotuma Yesu acirwa urubanza rwo gupfa.
Ariko, ntibaronka na kimwe, naho ivyabona vy’ibinyoma vyari vyaje ari vyinshi.
Ubwa nyuma, haza abantu babiri
bavuga bati: “Uwu mugabo yavuze ko ashobora gusambura urusengero rw’Imana, akarwubaka mu misi itatu.”
Hanyuma umuherezi mukuru aca arahaguruka, abwira Yesu ati: “None wewe nta co wireguza? Ibi birego bakwagiriza ubivugako iki?”
Ariko Yesu aguma ahoze.
Maze umuherezi mukuru aca amubwira ati: “Mw’izina ry’Imana nzima, tubwize ukuri: Uri Kristo, Umwana w’Imana?”
Yesu aramwishura ati:
Maze umuherezi mukuru yitaburirako impuzu, avuga ati: “Aratutse Imana! None hari ibindi vyabona dukeneye? Ubu na ho ntimwiyumviye ingene atutse Imana?
Mumucira urubanza ruki?”
Baramwishura bati: “Akwiye gupfa.”
Hanyuma bamucira amate mu maso, bamukubita ingumu, abandi bamukubita amakofe,
bavuga bati: “Ko uri Kristo, tubwire uwugukubise!”
Ico gihe, Petero yari yicaye hanze mu rugo. Maze umwigeme yakora ngaho, aramwegera avuga ati: “Na wewe wari kumwe na Yesu w’i Galilaya.”
Ariko Petero, arabihakana imbere yabo ati: “Sinzi n’ivyo muriko muravuga.”
Hanyuma aragenda ahagarara hafi y’irembo, uwundi mwigeme w’umukozi w’aho na we aramubona aca abwira abari ngaho ati: “Uwu mugabo yari kumwe na Yesu w’i Nazareti.”
Arongera arabihakana, ashirako n’indahiro ati: “Sindamuzi!”
Haheze akanya gato, abari bahagaze ngaho begera Petero bamubwira bati: “Ni ukuri na wewe uri umwe muri bo, kuko n’imvugo yawe, irakuranga ko uri Umunyagalilaya.”
Petero aca atangura kurahira yisiba ati: “Ndabarahiye urya muntu sindamuzi!”
Uwo mwanya nyene, isake ica irabika.
Petero aca yibuka ivyo Yesu yari yamubwiye ati:
Aca aja hanze araturikisha ararira cane.
